item.title: Review: 2026 Hyundai Elantra 1.6 HEV Premium 6DCT
item.description: Let’s admit one thing for a second: before the seventh-generation Elantra reached Philippine shores, the nameplate wasn’t synonymous with cutting-edge tech. While they’ve managed to re-write the design book on occasion, they often hide something more modest under the hood. This time, Hyundai has decided to go all out and pair those head-turning looks with a powertrain to match. The result? A great value hybrid compact sedan that’s also, gasp, fun to drive.Read More »

item.title: Toyota Corolla Cross GR Sport Gets Styling Tweaks This 2026
item.description: Remember when Toyota updated the Corolla Cross in 2024 and they curiously left the GR Sport variant untouched, at least aesthetically? Well, we probably know why. Just launched regionally is an updated version of the top-of-the-line Corolla Cross variant for 2026, and it could very well be making its way here.Read More »

item.title: The Ferrari Luce's Interior, Co-Designed By A Former Apple Designer, Looks Sick
item.description: Ferrari had us all fooled. When the brand unveiled the platform for its first all-electric offering last year, it came with the name, “Elettrica.” Apparently, that’s a mere placeholder because it’s just been renamed as the “Luce.”Read More »

item.title: Suzuki Philippines Strengthens Environmental Stewardship With Pawikan Release In Bataan
item.description: Suzuki Philippines reaffirmed its commitment to environmental conservation through a meaningful Pawikan (sea turtle) release activity held at the Pawikan Conservation Center in Morong, Bataan. The activity brought together Suzuki Philippines leaders and team members in support of marine wildlife protection and sustainability.Read More »

item.title: BYD Schools Japanese, Korean Brands By Updating Atto 3 With Up To 449 Horsepower
item.description: BYD has just schooled everyone, the Japanese and Korean makes included, on how vehicle updates are done. Case is point is the 2026 Atto 3—a vehicle that not only features more power, faster charger, and better range, but in the process also switches over to “right wheel drive.”Read More »

item.title: The 2026 Mazda CX-5 Cuts Cost To Give Customers More
item.description: Mazda’s relentless attention to detail, spanning to things unseen or unrealized by customers, is costing them money. That’s about to change starting with the all-new CX-5.Read More »

item.title: Meet Toyota's Largest BEV, the 2027 Highlander
item.description: Toyota introduced its largest battery electric vehicle yet, the all-new three-row 2027 Highlander. The Highlander is designed primarily for the North American market and will be assembled at the brand’s plant in Kentucky.Read More »
